metadata.name: vitepress
metadata.description: Vite & Vue powered static site generator for technical documentation

default.description: VitePress with non-interactive scaffold (docs/, .vitepress/config.js, npm scripts)
installScript: cd /d "${INSTALL_PATH}" && if not exist docs\.vitepress mkdir docs\.vitepress
cd /d "${INSTALL_PATH}\docs" && (if not exist index.md echo # Welcome > index.md)
cd /d "${INSTALL_PATH}\docs\.vitepress" && (if not exist config.js echo export default { title: "VitePress Site", description: "A VitePress site" } > config.js)
cd /d "${INSTALL_PATH}" && npm.cmd pkg set scripts.docs:dev="vitepress dev docs" scripts.docs:build="vitepress build docs" scripts.docs:preview="vitepress preview docs"

default.description: VitePress with non-interactive scaffold (docs/, .vitepress/config.js, npm scripts)
installScript:
test -f ${INSTALL_PATH}/docs/index.md || printf '# Welcome

This is a VitePress documentation site.
' > ${INSTALL_PATH}/docs/index.md
cd ${INSTALL_PATH} && npm pkg set scripts.docs:dev='vitepress dev docs' scripts.docs:build='vitepress build docs' scripts.docs:preview='vitepress preview docs'

aiPrompts.versionDiscovery: VitePress is distributed via npm. Check latest version at https://www.npmjs.com/package/vitepress
aiPrompts.updateGuidance: VitePress follows semantic versioning. Installing via npm always pulls the newest stable version. Major releases may require Node.js >= 18.
